info.title: Alchemy Polygon zkEVM JSON-RPC Specification
info.description: A specification of the standard JSON-RPC methods for Polygon zkEVM.

methods.name: eth_accounts
methods.description: Returns a list of addresses owned by the client.

result.name: Accounts
result.description: An array of account addresses owned by the client. Can be empty if no accounts are available.

methods.name: eth_blockNumber
methods.description: Returns the number of the most recent block.

result.name: Block number
result.description: The block number of the most recently mined block as a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: eth_call
methods.description: Executes a new message call immediately without creating a transaction on the blockchain.

params.name: Transaction
params.description: The transaction call object containing the details of the message call.

schema.title: Transaction object generic to all types

nonce.title: nonce
nonce.description: Number of prior transactions sent from the sender account.

to.title: to address
to.description: Recipient of the call. Use null to indicate contract creation.

oneOf.title: Contract Creation (null)
oneOf.description: Null to create a contract; the address is derived from sender and nonce.

oneOf.title: Address
oneOf.description: 20-byte address of the recipient account or contract.

value.title: value
value.description: Amount of Ether to transfer with the call, in wei.

gasPrice.title: gas price
gasPrice.description: The gas price willing to be paid by the sender in wei

maxPriorityFeePerGas.title: max priority fee per gas
maxPriorityFeePerGas.description: Maximum fee per gas the sender is willing to pay to miners in wei

maxFeePerGas.title: max fee per gas
maxFeePerGas.description: The maximum total fee per gas the sender is willing to pay (includes the network / base fee and miner / priority fee) in wei

maxFeePerBlobGas.title: max fee per blob gas
maxFeePerBlobGas.description: The maximum total fee per gas the sender is willing to pay for blob gas in wei

accessList.title: accessList
accessList.description: EIP-2930 access list of pre-touched addresses and storage keys.

blobVersionedHashes.title: blobVersionedHashes
blobVersionedHashes.description: List of versioned blob hashes associated with the transaction's EIP-4844 data blobs.

blobs.title: blobs
blobs.description: Raw EIP-4844 blob data (each item is a binary-encoded blob).

chainId.title: chainId
chainId.description: Chain ID that this transaction is valid on.

params.name: Block
params.description: The block number, tag, or hash at which to execute the call. Defaults to `'latest'` if not provided.

schema.title: Block number, tag, or block hash
schema.description: Identifies a block by explicit number, a predefined tag (e.g., latest/safe/finalized), or a 32-byte block hash.

anyOf.title: Block number
anyOf.description: Unsigned integer block height (e.g., 0 for genesis).

anyOf.title: Block tag
anyOf.description: A well-known tag such as "latest", "earliest", "pending", "safe", or "finalized".

anyOf.title: Block hash
anyOf.description: 32-byte Keccak hash of the block header identifying a specific block.

result.name: Return data
result.description: The return value of the executed contract function, encoded as a hexadecimal string.

oneOf.title: Block tag
oneOf.description: `earliest`: The lowest numbered block the client has available; `finalized`: The most recent crypto-economically secure block, cannot be re-orged outside of manual intervention driven by community coordination; `safe`: The most recent block that is safe from re-orgs under honest majority and certain synchronicity assumptions; `latest`: The most recent block in the canonical chain observed by the client, this block may be re-orged out of the canonical chain even under healthy/normal conditions; `pending`: A sample next block built by the client on top of `latest` and containing the set of transactions usually taken from local mempool. methods.name: eth_getLogs
methods.summary: Returns an array of all logs matching the specified filter.
methods.description:
Returns an array of all logs matching the specified filter.
### Supported Block Ranges
Here are the block ranges you're able to submit in a single query, depending on your plan tier:

> ⚠️ Note: All responses will be capped at 150MB.

| Chain | Free | Pay As You Go | Enterprise |
|-------|------|---------------|------------|
| Ethereum, Base, Optimism, Arbitrum, Worldchain, zkSync | 10 | unlimited | unlimited |
| Polygon | 10 | 2000 | unlimited |
| BSC, Unichain | 10 | 10,000 | 10,000 |
| Berachain, Plasma | 10 | 10,000 | 100,000 |
| Monad | 10 | 1000 | 1000 |
| Polygon zkEVM | 10 | 10,000 | 20,000 |
| Sei | 10 | 2000 | 2000 |
| All Other Chains | 10 | 10,000 | 10,000*** |

*** Note: Querying block ranges wider than 10k for these chains is possible but less likely to succeed. Try splitting large queries into smaller parts to boost performance and reduce the likelihood of failure.

methods.name: eth_sendRawTransaction
methods.summary: Submits a raw transaction to the network.
methods.description:
Submits a raw transaction (serialized and signed) for broadcasting to the network. The transaction data should be encoded as a hexadecimal string starting with `0x`. You can create and sign a transaction externally using libraries like [web3.js](https://web3js.readthedocs.io/) or [ethers.js](https://docs.ethers.org/). 

**Note:** For [EIP-4844](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-4844) transactions, the raw form must be in the network format, which includes blobs, KZG commitments, and KZG proofs.

params.name: Transaction
params.description: The raw transaction data to submit, encoded as a hexadecimal string.

result.name: Transaction hash
result.description: The hash of the submitted transaction, as a hexadecimal string.

on Polygon zkEVM, taking into account zkEVM's effective gas pricing.

approximate total fees (see `zkevm_estimateFee`).

methods.name: zkevm_isBlockConsolidated
methods.summary: Checks if a block is connected to a verified batch.
methods.description: Returns `true` if the provided block number is connected to a batch that has already been verified; otherwise, returns `false`.

params.name: blockNumber
params.description: The block number to check.

result.name: Is Block Consolidated
result.description: true if the block is connected to a verified batch; false otherwise.

methods.name: zkevm_isBlockVirtualized
methods.summary: Checks if a block is connected to a virtualized batch.
methods.description: Returns `true` if the provided block number is connected to a batch that has already been virtualized; otherwise, returns `false`.

params.name: blockNumber
params.description: The block number to check.

result.name: Is Block Virtualized
